title: Your first frets
summary: Move by semitones on the lowest string.
goal: Play frets 0–1–2–3, then 3–2–1–0 with a fresh pluck on every beat.
body: First complete the open-string lesson. A fret raises a note by one semitone. Put your fingertip just behind the metal fret, using only enough pressure for a clear note. Suggested fingers for frets 1/2/3 are index/middle/ring. Start at 60 BPM; 40–50 gives more time. Try 70 only after comfortable repeats.

return.body: Bar 2 begins with a new attack on fret 3, then descends: {{positions}}.

two-bars.title: 5. Join both bars
two-bars.body: Count four beats twice. Pluck every note, including the repeated note across the barline. {{positions}}.
